breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the periodic grid convention with Nx=512 points on [0,1), x_j=j*dx, and dx=1/Nx, matching the ground truth. It does not adopt the erroneous preamble instruction about Nx being the number of grid points including both endpoints with dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1).
